answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29266 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to rent out my commercial showroom to :- 1) a Restaurant who will serve alcohol alongwith food. 2) Insurance company . 3) Bank ? Question: Assalaamualeikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu. Dear Mufti Saheb. Is it permissible to rent out my commercial showroom to :- 1) a Restaurant who will serve alcohol alongwith food. 2) Insurance company . 3) Bank ?? JazakAllah Khairan. Answer ID: 29266 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 178/133/L=1432) It is lawful to give one's showroom on rent to a restaurant, an insurance company or a bank etc. However, it is better to avoid; because there is a kind of helping in sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
